Hi Brendon,

Thanks for flagging that. The parcel that landed on October 19 was the Overclocking add-on for your Bitfortun BS-2, and you're right that nothing with setup steps went in the box.

I've asked JD on our technical team for the install steps for the overclock kit on the BS-2, and he'll come back to you in this thread today.

If you'd rather not wait, he is quickest on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf . Post in the server and mention @nullhashrate, that's JD, and he can walk you through it live.

One thing worth knowing while you wait: your BS-2 runs fine as delivered, so there's no rush to change anything until you have the proper steps in hand.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
